subject: Engagement commitments — draft MAP and weekly pulse
messages:
From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@novumhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@novumhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 May 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + MAP draft

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo today — it was helpful to see the latency numbers on the streaming path. Quick follow-ups from our side: 1) procurement will need an initial list of all dependencies (cloud regions, network peering requirements, expected egress volumes) to route to our infra team; 2) we want the MAP to show a conservative target close (legal + procurement) — can we push target close to 2025-07-15 for now?

I attached a short note with the infra Qs we captured. Also, Evan suggested adding an explicit data residency checkbox in the MAP since some of our clinics are in CA and have state-level requirements.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Alyssa
Senior Product Manager
Novum Health
[Attachment: novum_infra_questions.pdf (pdf, 23 KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + MAP draft

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the quick note and the infra list. I pulled together a revised MAP draft that: lists dependencies, shifts proposed target close to 2025-07-15, and adds a data-residency action item for Legal/Compliance. Please see the attached v1.3.

Quick callouts so we're aligned: 
- Milestones: Pilot deploy (POC) by 2025-06-20; Security assessment complete by 2025-06-30; Pilot conclusion and feedback loop by 2025-07-10; Target close (contract signature) 2025-07-15 (conservative).
- Owners: Novum = Evan (technical) + Alyssa (product); Redwood = Ben (engagement lead) + Marissa (solutions).
- Dependencies: network peering (Novum infra), SOC2 audit artifacts (Novum legal), and a small sandbox dataset for QA (Novum data team).

Can you confirm: 1) the PO team is ok with the 20 Jun POC target; and 2) should we route the data residency checkbox directly to your legal team or keep it as an internal note for now?

Next steps: Ben will reach out with proposed pilot windows once Novum confirms infra availability. I'll plan a weekly 15-minute checkpoint starting next Monday — same time as our demo if that works.

Attachments: Novum_MAP_v1.3.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Novum_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (xlsx, 42 KB)]

From: Evan Liu <evan.liu@novumhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@novumhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 29 May 2025 11:25:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + MAP draft

Marissa — looping in answers from infra:
- Network peering: our infra team can provision peering in us-west-2 and us-east-1; peering setup lead time ~7 business days once we have IP ranges.
- Egress volumes: estimate ~120TB/month for full pilot; will refine once we have tokenization and sampling numbers.
- Data residency: legal prefers the checkbox routed to them directly; I'll add Legal (procurement@novumhealth.com) on any MAP revisions that include residency items.

POC window 2025-06-16 to 2025-06-20 looks good from infra (we'll confirm by EOD Monday).

One ask from infra: can Redwood include a short table in the MAP listing minimal firewall and port rules? That speeds our handoff.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Liu
Cloud Infrastructure Lead, Novum Health

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@novumhealth.com>, Evan Liu <evan.liu@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@novumhealth.com
Date: Fri, 30 May 2025 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Revised MAP v1.4 — firewall table + updated milestones

Hi all — per Evan's infra notes and Alyssa's request, attached is MAP v1.4. Changes from v1.3:
- Added a minimal firewall/ports table under "Infra dependencies" (rows: port, purpose, direction, recommended rule).
- Updated target close to 2025-07-15 and tightened milestone dates to reflect confirmed POC window 6/16–6/20.
- Added a "Data residency" checkbox routed to procurement@novumhealth.com and legal for explicit sign-off.
- Flagged two overdue items for Novum: sandbox dataset delivery (due 2025-06-05) and SOC2 artifacts list (due 2025-06-10).

Ben, can you follow up with the pilot scheduling options this morning? I'll plan to kick off the weekly 15-min checkpoint on Mon 2025-06-02 10:00 AM PT — let me know if that conflicts.

Attachment: Novum_MAP_v1.4.xlsx

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Novum_MAP_v1.4.xlsx (xlsx, 58 KB)]
